screening_method: SPUS official holdings (SP Funds public daily CSV)
stock_note: Stock universe is the current official holdings of SPUS (SP Funds S&P 500 Sharia Industry Exclusions ETF), downloaded from the fund's public daily holdings file. Holdings date on the file: 11/11/2026. 215 equity names after dropping cash and non-tickers. SPUS applies an AAOIFI-style industry exclusion screen at the fund level; this bot does not re-screen those names and does not issue a fatwa.
crypto_note: This crypto list is a screening assumption for paper trading, not a fatwa and not investment advice. It is limited to large, liquid, utility-network coins. Meme coins, lending/interest or yield tokens, leveraged tokens, futures, and shorting are out of scope. Many scholars disagree on whether any cryptocurrency is permissible, and some specifically object to proof-of-stake coins because of staking rewards that resemble interest. This bot never stakes, lends, or earns yield; it only paper-trades the coins at spot.
data_sources: Nasdaq public quote API (historical + last sale) for US-listed stocks; Yahoo Finance spark as fallback
CoinGecko public API for crypto spot and 24h volume
Binance Vision public klines for crypto hourly history
